criteria.basis: Installed Session/SessionDriver and journey expose finite DAG creation/claim, eligible-agent replacement, lease epochs/reclaim, cancel/revoke, one reservation/receipt ledger, explicit unknown calls, known-receipt retrieval, verified artifacts, bounded contexts/mailboxes and replaceable model/tool callbacks. R5 exercises declared failure boundaries; unresolved and unavailable are preserved.
criteria.criterion: Finite lifecycle, resource and recovery path

criteria.basis: R1 tests provenance deduplication/local relevance/version reactivation with dedup+TTL controls and component ablations. R2 tests eligible allocation/work stealing/congestion and reconciles capacity with zero dedicated reserve. R4 records actual dispatched logical identities under resource limits. No general scaling or reserve-policy advantage is claimed.
criteria.criterion: Local coordination mechanism and allocation experiments

criteria.basis: R3/G5/R4 consume actual tool feedback in subsequent model requests while the common final evaluator remains separate. Session calls and publications require current permission/lease/work state and fresh public-core authorization; attention/model responses/old checkpoints cannot grant authority. This is not learned reinforcement or adaptive escalation evidence.

Completed phase evidence includes actual deterministic pilots, real-model closed-loop studies and one 38-case Session fault collection; full R4 replication and R5 v2 audit gates are accepted. Earlier format failures, the original R4 INVALID grid, v1 checker mismatch and all known/unknown/unavailable costs remain retained. Negative efficacy findings meet research-phase reporting requirements without promoting candidates.
criteria.criterion: R1 through R5 actual phase evidence

criteria.basis: Frozen configs/source/model/interpreter/task/evaluator identities, raw requests/receipts, SQLite/Trace reconciliation, shared evaluator/accounting within policy studies and versioned paired-world exports are retained. Pilots are nonconfirmatory; repeated agents/calls/worlds are not new independent units.

The source-identified experimental Session v1 new-database cohort has a concrete installed consumer and wheel/sdist acceptance. Historical G1/PilotLedger consumers remain explicit and never also charge Session calls. Root must finish exact archive retention, final compatibility/consumer decision and master acceptance; no additional implementation or study run was identified as necessary for the accepted finite scope.
criteria.criterion: Concrete API cohort and final exit

future_maturity_or_generalization_limits: No eight-hour or 24-hour soak was performed; lifetime Trace/SQLite growth is not bounded by work/call caps alone.
Dynamic task admission, general worker supervision and a persistent service loop are outside the accepted finite consumer.
Logical N is not physical GPU concurrency; hardware scaling and model-family/task-population generalization are unproven.

Trusted callbacks/reference authority store do not prove arbitrary effect exactly-once, general sandboxing, hostile-host issuer custody, power-loss/multi-host durability or arbitrary corruption repair.
